title: The February Revolution begins in Petrograd
summary: Protests and strikes over bread shortages broke out in Petrograd and grew into a revolt joined by soldiers, forcing Tsar Nicholas II to abdicate within a week.
reason: War losses, food shortages and contempt for the Tsar's government had made the regime deeply unpopular.
significance: It ended three centuries of Romanov rule and opened the path to the Bolshevik seizure of power.
